editorial.blurb: Lotus Banh Mi delivers exceptionally fresh Vietnamese classics with generous portions and notably soft, quality bread that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the banh mi with extra meat if you want a heartier sandwich — the pork banh mi is a standout, and service is quick enough that you can easily grab it to go.

topDishes.note: Praised for the softest, highest-quality bread and flavorful, fresh fillings
Delicious and even better with extra meat
